address: S Grand Fork Way, Meridian (SW quadrant of Overland Rd & Ten Mile Rd)
owner_name: Not individually published (Ada County withholds owners). Master-developer land assembly attributable to Brighton Corporation (Ten Mile Crossing); platted lots owned by homebuilders (e.g. CBH Homes) and homeowners.
owner_type: Regional master developer (Brighton Corp) + production homebuilders; not a single owner across 92.5 ac / 8 parcels.
ownership_since: unknown (Brighton assembled/developed Ten Mile Crossing through the 2010s-2020s); no per-parcel figures found.
who_they_are: Brighton Corporation = Meridian-based master developer (founded 1968) controlling the Ten Mile Crossing 'west gateway' district at the I-84/Ten Mile interchange; Grand Fork Way / Spanish Fork Way sit inside it. CBH Homes actively building single-family here.
intent_summary: SM-4 is the RESIDENTIAL portion (R-15/R-8/R-4/R-2; FLU High/Medium-Density Residential + Civic) of Ten Mile Crossing at SW Overland & Ten Mile. Partially built: Cortland South Meridian apartments + CBH single-family; remaining R-15 High-Density parcels planned/entitled for more multifamily. NOTE: the Assemble Management/Realm 200-unit 'Overland apartments' project is a SEPARATE ~7-ac parcel ~4 mi east at 4270 E Overland (Rolling Hill) — 154-unit Realm proposal DENIED 2024; Assemble's 200-unit re-file APPROVED by Council May 19 2026.
project_status: partially built + planned/dormant HDR parcels (Ten Mile Crossing district)

address: 3500 W Cobalt Dr, Meridian (Ten Mile/I-84 interchange employment core)
owner_name: Multiple owners (197.9 ac / 32 parcels). Predominantly Brighton Corporation (Ten Mile Crossing / TM Creek); Outer Banks Subdivision portion held by a separate applicant group; SCS Development also active. No single owner.
owner_type: Master developer (Brighton Corp) + multiple investors/developers within the Ten Mile Interchange Specific Area Plan (TMISAP) employment core.
ownership_since: unknown per parcel; Brighton developing Ten Mile Crossing since the interchange opened (2011).
who_they_are: TMISAP 'High-Density Employment' district — Meridian's designated west employment/mixed-use gateway. Brighton Corporation the dominant master developer; SCS Development another major player.
intent_summary: TMISAP high-density employment/mixed-use core with heavy multifamily already delivered along Cobalt Dr: The Flats at Ten Mile (~235 units, 2021), The Lofts at Ten Mile, Cortland at Ten Mile. Outer Banks Subdivision approved Dec 2021 (~516 units: 364 apartments + 126 flats + 26 townhomes). Adjacent Ten Mile Crossing/TM Creek continues office + high-density residential phases. A district, not a single deal — remaining employment parcels planned/partly dormant.
project_status: mixed — several built/under construction (Flats, Lofts, Cortland) + approved (Outer Banks 2021); balance planned.

address: 1074 S Silverstone Way, Meridian (Rackham Subdivision; Eagle Rd & I-84 node)
owner_name: Not publicly published (Ada County restriction). In the Rackham master-planned subdivision; the R-40 apartment parcel was developed as 'Aren.' Rackham master-developer entity not definitively identified.
owner_type: Master-planned mixed-use subdivision at a regional commercial/employment node (Silverstone / Eagle View Landing).
ownership_since: unknown; Rackham platted/built over the early-2020s.
who_they_are: Rackham = mixed-use subdivision at Eagle Rd & I-84 (one of Idaho's busiest interchanges), part of the greater Silverstone / Eagle View Landing node (office, medical, retail, hotel, ICCU HQ). FLU Mixed Use-Regional; zoning C-G + R-40.
intent_summary: The R-40 (high-density) component has ALREADY been built as 'Aren' apartments (4 stories, 396 units, 2024). Remaining C-G / Mixed-Use-Regional parcels are commercial/office pads. Multifamily-competitive capacity here is largely realized (Aren) with residual commercial land developable.
project_status: built (Aren R-40, 396 units, 2024) + commercial; residual C-G pads developable.

address: 2820 S Eagle Rd, Meridian (with 2910/2960/2990/3020 S Eagle Rd)
owner_name: BPS Eagle Road, LLC (per City of Meridian staff report H-2022-0066 'Artisan Victory Market'). Address of record: 1401 17th Street Ste 700, Denver, CO 80202.
owner_type: Out-of-state (Denver) real-estate investment / land-holding LLC; land was rural residential/agricultural before assembly.
ownership_since: unknown (held by BPS Eagle Road LLC as of the 2022-2023 application; no price disclosed).
who_they_are: BPS Eagle Road LLC = Denver, CO holding entity that assembled the five Eagle Rd parcels. 2022-23 entitlement engineer was Kindi Moosman of Horrocks Engineers. In 2026 a new merchant developer, Quarterra (multifamily arm of national homebuilder Lennar), is pursuing the site.
intent_summary: Two overlapping plans on the same ~13-ac Eagle Rd assemblage. (1) 2022-23 'Artisan Victory Market' (H-2022-0066): annex 14.47 ac to R-15 + C-C; plat 5 lots; CUP for 131 build-to-rent multifamily units + 18,100 sf commercial; staff/P&Z recommended approval (2023). (2) As of June 2026, Quarterra/Lennar filed a pre-application 'Emblem Meridian' for 250 units (apartments + townhomes) on ~13 ac just north of Eagle & Victory, with clubhouse/pool/dog park. Site remains developable (Artisan unbuilt); Emblem is the current active proposal.
project_status: proposed/entitled, not built — Artisan approved 2023 unbuilt; superseded by Quarterra 'Emblem Meridian' 250-unit concept (pre-app June 2026).
